# Win Process Control Engineering

> Manufacturer of instrumentation valves, tube & pipe fittings and engineering components for high pressure, temperature and vacuum applications. Established 2018, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Brands: WIN-VAL (valves), WIN-LOK (fittings), WIN-FIT (engineering components).

## Products
- Manifold Valves: 2/3/5-way manifolds for pressure and DP transmitters
- Ball Valves: bar stock & investment cast, 2PC / 3PC designs
- Needle Valves: bar stock, straight and angle patterns
- Globe Valve: forged body, screwed bonnet & OS&Y bonnet
- Gate Valve: cast body, screwed bonnet
- Non Return Valve: inline check valves
- Tube Fittings: double ferrule connectors, unions, elbows, tees, crosses, plugs, caps
- Pipe Fittings: couplings, elbows, tees, crosses, unions, nipples, adaptors
- High Pressure Fittings: coned-and-threaded elbows, tees and crosses
- Valve Fittings: sealant injectors, check valves, drain plugs
- Quick Release Coupling: single check / double check
- Condensate / Seal Pot: 3-way and 4-way
- Air Header: bar stock and seamless pipe instrument air distribution headers
- Syphon: U-bend and Q-bend gauge syphons
- Thermowells: threaded, flanged and weld-in, made to drawing

## Materials
Stainless steel, carbon steel, alloy steel, nickel alloy, brass, bronze, CF8M / CF8.

## Industries served
Petrochemical, semiconductor, energy, food, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, defence, pulp & paper, mining.
